Subject: Proposal: switch renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Joe —

Thanks again for the great conversation earlier. As we talked about, HearthTech's renewal is coming up on 2027-03-15 and we wanted to propose moving future invoices to the AWS Marketplace to simplify procurement and enable your cloud-finance teams to manage charges through existing cloud contracts.

Key benefits we see for HearthTech:
- One consolidated invoice through AWS Marketplace, aligning with your cloud spend governance
- Faster procurement cycles for future expansions (no new vendor onboarding)
- AWS co-sell support available if you want to expand into additional accounts

Proposed next steps (low friction):
1) We provide a Marketplace Amendment that maps your current contract to a Marketplace entitlement
2) You sign the amendment (DocuSign) and AWS processes entitlement; you can pay via your existing AWS billing account
3) Redwood issues next renewal invoice via Marketplace on your renewal date

I'm attaching a short Marketplace Amendment sketch and a draft SOW outlining how we'll handle metering/entitlements during the cutover. We can be flexible on price parity — if you prefer we can keep the same unit economics or apply a one-time credit to smooth the migration.

Would love to get confirmation of the right procurement contact and whether your finance team requires a PO or prefers Marketplace invoicing only.

If this sounds good I suggest we aim to have the amendment signed by 2027-02-25 to leave a buffer for AWS processing.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

[Attachment: SOW_hearthtech_draft.docx]
